verdict.rationale: The documented API can search contacts by field, list, status, or date and can create or merge lists. These are building blocks an agent could use to assemble a static list. There is no documented API for creating a saved segment from criteria. Segmentation appears only as a product feature with no programmatic surface, so the core capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can translate a plain-language audience description into a real segment via the platform's programmatic surface
